CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.
   C. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
